Package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.resourceserver

Class RestDocumentGateway

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.resourceserver.RestDocumentGateway
All Implemented Interfaces:
DocumentGateway
@Component public class RestDocumentGateway extends Object implements DocumentGateway
Implements the documents port with the client generated from the resource server's contract. The call runs on behalf of the signed-in user (the REST client adds the user's access token) and every failure becomes a domain exception: a missing or unrenewable token and a 401 are unauthorized, except a 401 carrying a step-up challenge (RFC 9470), which asks for a stronger or more recent authentication; a 403 is forbidden, a 404 not found, and an unreachable resource server or any other answer unavailable. No token is ever logged.
